Step 1: Sign up – We’ll build a custom meal plan and start you on a 2‑week trial, then ongoing deliveries every 4 weeks.

Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

Sent · Just now

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here’s a quick, simple breakdown of your main options with us:

Start a trial: Sign up, get a 2-week trial meal plan for your dog, then it rolls into a recurring delivery every 4 weeks.
Customize meals: On your Pets page, you can:
Pick or change recipes
Choose fixed (same recipes every time) or rotate (switch recipes each order)
Set portion size (full or half portions)
Choose how many meal packs per day your dog gets
Adjust portions & feeding: View exact feeding instructions and portions any time in your Feeding Guide on the Pets page.
Manage your account: In your account you can change:
What’s in each order
Delivery timing and address
Payment details and view order history
Add or remove dogs: You can add a new dog by building a new meal plan on the Pets page. To remove a dog, we currently ask that you chat with a Pet Support Specialist.
Add extras: On the Extras page, you can add:
Treats and probiotics
Choose One time (just next box) or Every box (recurring)
Try samples first: If you don’t want to commit yet, you can buy a Variety Pack or single packs through retail partners like Chewy, Amazon, and PetSmart.
Buy without a subscription: You can also get our meals (and some extras) through online and select in-store retailers such as PetSmart, Amazon, and Chewy.

In short, you can: try us out, customize everything for your dog, add fun extras, manage deliveries and payments, and even shop retail if a subscription isn’t your style.
